purpose: Contextual production priors for TrackSmith reasoning, clarification, candidate generation, preservation, and evaluation. This is not a preset library or a set of target curves.
epistemic_policy: Genre and aesthetic labels are uncertain, overlapping priors that must remain subordinate to the user's stated intent, negations, scoped references, artist and project history, source role, section, and audible evidence.
A professional case establishes what worked in one documented production, not a genre law. A measurement study supplies diagnostic priors, not artistic targets.
No genre entry authorizes a fixed spectrum, loudness, dynamics, stereo, timing, ambience, or processor setting.
When plausible interpretations would produce materially different edits, TrackSmith must clarify or expose reversible alternatives instead of silently choosing a stereotype.
No-change is a valid candidate when a supposed defect carries performance, groove, space, identity, narrative, or historical-production value.

global_reasoning_rules.rule: Resolve explicit desired, negative, and referential intent first; then artist/project/session provenance; then source, role, and section; then genre/aesthetic priors; finally measurements and candidate listening evidence.
Allow multiple genre and aesthetic memberships with separate confidence and scope. Never force one mutually exclusive label.
Treat an accepted rough or preview as a set of candidate preservation locks, not merely a spectral target.
Use measurements to locate risks, compare branches, enforce safety and translation guardrails, and document change; never use them alone to declare artistic correctness.
Clarify when an adjective, reference, or genre prior admits branches with materially different preservation costs.
When clarification would interrupt flow, present a small number of named, reversible, loudness-matched branches with predicted tradeoffs.
For cleanup, timing, dynamics, and limiting edits, expose what is removed or changed and include a no-change branch when identity value is plausible.
Carry evidence class, source scope, confidence, contradiction, and prohibited inference through every recommendation.

coverage_limits: The requested map is centered on broad, mostly Western commercial genre labels; it does not represent global traditions or all regional scenes.

Several umbrella terms, especially indie, R&B, EDM, ambient, hyperpop, lo-fi, cinematic, and acoustic, are historically unstable or describe production, market, instrumentation, or scene as much as musical genre.

Evidence is strongest for the documented artist cases and weaker for broad transfer; classical, contemporary metal subgenres, soul, folk, and acoustic music need more specialist primary cases and controlled listening research.

Public-page sources in the genre-aesthetic manifest were deeply read but await immutable ingestion and archive-generated hashes; this map labels that boundary rather than claiming archived full-text status.
No entry establishes population-level preference, a fixed target curve, an automatic genre classifier, or an emotion-from-audio ground truth.
